text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, on my way back from shopping with Tokai Teio…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh? There's a bunch of people gathering over there. I wonder what's going on?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: How about the lovely parent and child over there? Care to try your luck?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm not a child!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But, ooh, it's a raffle! Hehe, I'm super good at those too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: This one time, I was on such a winning streak that I got called a lucky charm!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! I got a raffle ticket from the game shop earlier, so we should give it a go!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Let's crank the spinner together! That's teamwork!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While crossing our fingers for a big prize, the two of us crank the raffle spinner's handle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat?! The grand-prize?! Oh my gosh, oh my gosh, YESSS!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What did I tell you? Am I great or what?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Now that's what I'm talking about! Hehe! Hahaha! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio skips around happily. She seems to be over the moon.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Okay, now I've just gotta invite someone to come with me! And of course, there's only one person I wanna ask!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yep, you got it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wait, but then again… Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Should I really invite Prez? Now that I think about it, I'm not so sure…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Can I really go to the hot springs with her right after I made a New Year's wish to take her down?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I've got more important things to focus on right now, and I dunno if Prez would agree to it, either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems that as Tokai Teio gets stronger, her way of thinking has also changed.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know! Can you hold on to this ticket for now, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: This probably isn't the right time to invite anyone. I wanna wait until after all the Twinkle Series stuff has calmed down.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Once that time comes, I'll invite the person I can have the most fun with. That sound good?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Thanks a lot! Hopefully by then, I'll be the undisputed Monarch of the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Then the hot spring owner and all the chefs and stuff will be like, "Whoa! It's the invincible Teio!" It'll be amazing!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Then they'll give me a bunch of sashimi, and put, like, loads of rubber duckies in my bath!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daydreaming of a royal welcome, Tokai Teio is flooded with motivation as she thinks about all the fun things the future holds.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Only first? Aww maaan, I wanted the grand -prize! This is pretty good too, though.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Check out how amazing it looks! So juicy and tender!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …Wait. Trainer, I bet you're thinking it's childish of me to get all excited over a hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But you know what's really childish? Judging people like that! I mean, everyone likes hamburger steak, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So let's eat it together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know! We should put a tasty fried egg on top too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We share the egg-topped steak. Her smile as she eats is filled with more glee than I've ever seen a child express.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Aww, second-prize? I thought I had it there for a second. Ah, well. Them's the breaks.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whoa, this sure is a lot of carrots, though! I wonder what I can use them all for…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I know! I can throw a carrot party!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Well, first I get all my friends together. Then we chat and play a bunch of games…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Then we tell jokes and do acrobatics! And magic tricks! And quizzes!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh, I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Carrots? Oh, right, the carrots. We can eat those when we get hungry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …It seems the carrots are just an afterthought compared to the party. What she really wants to do is hang out with her friends.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hurry up, Trainer! Let's get this party started! Ah, this carrot party, that is!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, the carrots provided the perfect excuse for Tokai Teio to have a great time, and left everyone thoroughly sated.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third-prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whaaaat?! One measly carrot? Can't we at least have two? One for me and my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her protests go unanswered and we only receive one carrot.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Grr, what a rip-off. Should we at least do something with it before we eat it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, I know! I'll use it to pose like Prez!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She hoists the carrot up to the sky.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You get what this pose means?
choice_data_list: That you won the first leg of the Triple Crown?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Noooo!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It means I'm gonna win the next race too, so I'm gonna need two carrots!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Soooo… can I have another one? Pretty please?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: No can do.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Okay, how about three? Then I'll do the Triple Carrot Crown pose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her logic making less sense by the second, Tokai Teio is ultimately forced to give in and munch on a single crunchy carrot.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: N-no way! Just tissues?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Where'd all my luck go?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wait a second. Trainer, are you an unlucky person?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I see. For whatever reason, my luck ran out today.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I don't ever wanna remember this day, so I'll give these tissues to you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For once, Tokai Teio seems depressed. I guess everyone has their unlucky days.
